title.zh: 走进法治天地 · 建设法治中国

clips.send: The staircase of offences. Three kinds of unlawful act. An unlawful act is one that breaks the law and so must bear legal responsibility. By which law is broken, there are three kinds: civil, administrative and criminal. Civil and administrative offences are “ordinary offences” (一般违法). Criminal offences are crimes (犯罪) — the most harmful. Drag the slider to watch one quarrel climb the stairs.

clips.send: Six shields around every minor. Why do minors get special protection? Minors are still growing in body and mind; they lack experience and self-protection ability, and are easily harmed. They are the future of the country, so the state gives them special, priority protection. China’s Law on the Protection of Minors (未成年人保护法) names six kinds of protection. Click all six sectors.

clips.send: What is law? A special kind of rule with three features. Life is full of rules: family rules, school rules, manners, morality. The textbook says law is different from all of them in three ways — click the three cards. Then click “What law does” to see why the textbook calls law “the guarantee of our life”.

clips.send: Governing the country by law. Four links, one chain. The textbook: governing the country by law is the basic way the Communist Party of China leads the people in running the country. It asks four things of four groups. Put each requirement on the link it belongs to: tap a card, then tap a slot (or drag it). When the chain is complete, click each link to learn more.

clips.send: 未成年人的六大保护。为什么要给予未成年人特殊保护？。未成年人身心发育尚不成熟，自我保护能力较弱，辨别是非和自我控制能力不强，容易受到不良因素的影响和不法侵害。。未成年人是祖国的未来、民族的希望，需要给予特殊保护。。《中华人民共和国未成年人保护法》规定了六大保护，请点击全部六个扇形。

clips.send: 违法行为的“阶梯”。违法行为分三类。违法行为是指出于过错，违反法律、法规的规定，危害社会的行为；违法就要承担法律责任。。根据违反法律的类别，分为民事违法行为、行政违法行为和刑事违法行为。。民事违法和行政违法属于一般违法行为；刑事违法行为就是犯罪，社会危害性最严重。。拖动滑块，看一场争吵怎样一步步“升级”。

clips.send: 依法治国。四个环节，缺一不可。教材指出：依法治国是党领导人民治理国家的基本方略。。它对四个环节提出了四项基本要求。请把每项要求放到对应的环节上：先点卡片，再点空格（也可以拖动）。。拼好之后，点击每个环节查看要点。

clips.send: 法律是什么？。具有三个特征的特殊行为规范。生活中有各种规则：家规、校规、礼仪、道德。。教材指出，法律与它们相比有三个显著特征——请依次点击三张卡片。。再点击“法律的作用”，看看为什么说法律是我们生活的保障。
